metadata.title: KARAY Models
metadata.description: Professional management, marketing and development agency for content creators.

hero.imageAlt: Model on a yacht in Rio de Janeiro
hero.headline: We turn your content into a profitable, long-term business.
hero.highlight: Yes, you can block Brazil (or any other country) on OnlyFans to protect your privacy.
hero.body: Strategy, management, marketing and professional support for creators who want to build a strong brand, grow their earnings and reach financial freedom.

whyUs.headline: We build brands. We change lives.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: End-to-end planning for your brand's positioning, identity and growth.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Promotion across multiple platforms to attract real, qualified and engaged fans.

chats.title: Chat Management
chats.description: Professional chatters focused on relationships, retention and higher sales.

analytics.title: Analytics and Optimization
analytics.description: Metrics tracking and continuous improvements to maximize your results.

security.title: Security
security.description: Professional infrastructure to protect your account, your brand and your information.

difference.headline: Your business deserves far more than generic management.
difference.body: We build a complete structure around your brand so you can focus on creating content while our team works on growing your business.

invest.title: We Invest in You
invest.description: From day one, we invest time, experience, technology and resources to help you build a professional business that lasts.

onlyThirty.title: Only 30 Models
onlyThirty.description: We cap the agency's size to guarantee individual attention, constant communication and genuinely tailored strategies.

partnership.title: A Real Partnership
partnership.description: We don't see you as just another account. Your growth is treated as an essential part of our agency's growth.

transparency.title: Full Transparency
transparency.description: You can follow results, earnings, metrics and your business's performance with complete clarity.

management.title: Professional Management
management.description: We handle strategy, content, chats, sales, marketing, pricing, analysis and brand development.

growth.title: Continuous Growth
growth.description: Your account is never on autopilot. We review results and adjust the strategy constantly.

split.headline: Every party has a clear role in growing the brand.
split.body: After platform fees, revenue is split transparently between the model, the agency's management team and the company responsible for marketing.

model.label: Model
model.description: The largest share of revenue belongs to the creator and her brand.

agency.label: Agency
agency.description: Day-to-day management, strategy, sales, support and optimization.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Promotion, traffic, campaigns and audience growth.

footer.aboutBody: KARAY Models is an agency specializing in the complete management of content creators. Our goal is to turn talent into a profitable business through professional marketing strategies, brand positioning, account management, subscriber care and sustainable growth.
footer.aboutLimit: We cap the agency at just 30 models so we can offer personalized service and the highest level of support to every creator.
footer.serviceBody: We work with models across Brazil, Latin America and other countries. Recruiting, management and support are handled entirely online.
footer.whatsappPurpose: Use this number to ask questions, get information about the agency or check on your application.
footer.whatsappResponse: Our team usually replies within 24 hours.
